description: Get a compact profile of an entity from its current KRS extract: NIP/REGON (with NIP status), seat and address, contact and e-delivery address, share capital, representation (who can act for the entity and how: the board's composition by function and the representation rule, commercial proxies, attorneys; liquidators or a trustee when applicable), supervisory board, owners (shareholders that are companies are named, people are not), PKD activity codes, purpose and public-benefit status for associations, branches, and a one-line status assessment. Personal data is never returned. The register (P/S) is optional – both are checked when omitted.

rejestr.description: Rejestr: P – przedsiębiorców, S – stowarzyszeń. Pomiń, aby sprawdzić oba rejestry.
